notes.title: Discord & Playtest Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have some good news!

Coming March we will be releasing our playtest build to the public. We would very much appreciate any feedback, suggestions & bugs you may think of or find.

This playtest will be the first version releasing to the public, so going in be aware this build is for feedback, rather than long term game play.

Below is a link to our Discord, we encourage you to join & submit any feedback you may have and to join our slowly growing community!
